name: Teruhime
source:
Sister-in-law to Matsudaira, she lives in Aizu after her divorce from her husband. She is a friend and supporter to Suzuka, and they often exchange letters.

[From [url=http://hajimenokizu.com/bakumatsu-renka-shinsengumi/basic_info.html]BRS no Koibito[/url]]
